svg.text: a Collatz map on the Eisenstein integers ℤ[ω]
z ↦ z/2 if 2 | z, else (2−ω)z + c(z)
c(z) = the unit ≡ (2−ω)z mod 2(1−ω), times the power of 1−ω in (2−ω)z
564 of 840 starts prime to 1−ω, |a|,|b|,|a−b| ≤ 20, reach a cycle; 63 reach 1
276 pass 1e+15 or 3000 steps first: not drawn
gold: 6 two-cycles 1 ↔ 2 and its rotations, 378 starts
rose: one 42-cycle through 1+4ω; every 7 steps it turns z into −ω·z; 186 starts
f(uz) = u·f(z) for all six units u: turning the picture 60° is multiplying by a unit
all 1,260 hexagon starts, multiples of 1−ω too: 39 cycles, 912 caught, 348 escaped
f((1−ω)z) = (1−ω)f(z), so those are copies of these · turn +0.13 dividing, −0.27 multiplying
